projects: Operates 5 Sapphire-branded hotels with restaurant partners (Mangal Steak House, Ocakbasi 62 Mangal, SOCIETE); runs a three-tier loyalty program
importSignal: Website offers a Chinese-language version, suggesting openness to Chinese guests/suppliers
fitReason: Multi-property hotel group with a recurring, replaceable need for hotel-grade RFID/smart door locks and access control across guestrooms.
angle: Pitch a hotel-lock integration package (RFID/mobile-key guestroom locks, back-of-house access control) for retrofit and new rooms across their 5 properties; leverage their Chinese-language site to engage in Chinese and offer a pilot at one property before group-wide rollout.
